title: Last Earthquakes
subtitle: Real-time tracker for the last 100 earthquakes in Turkey with interactive map view, sorting, and risk zone visualization.

sections.description: A real-time app showing the last 100 earthquakes recorded in Turkey. Tap any event to see its epicenter on the map along with depth and magnitude details. You can also view the Turkey seismic risk map.
features: Last 100 earthquakes fetched in real time
Interactive Google Maps view with epicenter marker
Depth, magnitude, and location details per event
Turkey seismic risk zone map overlay
